card.name: Armenian dance
card.tagline: One of the world's oldest, most varied dance heritages
card.profile: Armenian dance (Հայկական պար, bar) is considered one of the oldest and most varied dance traditions of its region, with rock paintings of country dancing in the Armenian highlands dating from the fifth to third millennia BC (Wikipedia). Dances are typically circle or line forms accompanied by folk instruments — the duduk, zurna and dhol — and traditional taraz costume. The repertoire ranges from ritual and military dances to wedding, solo and duet forms, historically divided by age and gender.
card.insight: Composer Komitas observed that "dance expresses the typical characteristics of every nation, especially its traditions and degree of civilization"; Armenian dance has been successfully exported to international folk- and circle-dance communities and remains central to diaspora identity (Wikipedia; ArmGeo).
